R440.note: Reads and checks PNG/JPEG magic bytes, seeks back to 0 before Save(); correct and preserves upload behavior.

R441.note: snprintf with capacity check replaces strcpy/strcat; oversized input is rejected rather than silently truncated, and that behavior change is explicitly stated.

R442.note: AESGCM is the right replacement mode, but the fixed code calls message.encode('utf-8') on `message`, which the unchanged earlier line already converted to bytes -- this raises AttributeError on every request, breaking the endpoint entirely, and the write-up doesn't flag it.
